Case Study

Enterprise Insurance Platform

Insurance | Enterprise Application | Full Stack | Cloud

← All Case Studies

Business Layer

Application Layer

API Layer

Service Layer

Data Layer

Cloud Infrastructure

Executive Summary

An enterprise insurance platform focused on complex business workflows, secure APIs, structured modules and cloud-ready delivery.

Business Problem

Insurance operations often span fragmented policy workflows, manual handoffs and disconnected systems that reduce visibility and slow delivery.

Existing Architecture

Legacy or siloed application patterns with tightly coupled UI/business logic and limited reuse across operational modules.

Challenges

Complex domain workflows, authentication/authorization needs, integration points, reliability expectations and long-term maintainability.

Proposed Architecture

A layered enterprise architecture separating presentation, application services, APIs, data and cloud infrastructure with clear module boundaries.

Technical Architecture

Frontend application layer → API gateway/services → domain services → data stores → cloud infrastructure, with secure auth and integration adapters.

Frontend

Modern React-based interfaces for operational workflows, dashboards and process-driven screens.

Backend & APIs

Node.js / .NET services exposing REST APIs for policy, workflow and operational use cases.

Database

Relational data modeling with PostgreSQL/SQL Server patterns for transactional business records.

Authentication & Security

Authentication/authorization controls, secure API design and protected operational access paths.

Cloud Infrastructure

AWS-oriented deployment patterns supporting scalable services, environment separation and operational monitoring.

Business Workflows & Integrations

Structured process flows and integrations that connect insurance operations across systems.

My Role

Full stack engineering and solution architecture support across application design, APIs, workflows and delivery.

Results / Impact

Improved operational visibility and reduced fragmented manual processes through a centralized application approach.

Lessons Learned

Clear domain boundaries, secure API contracts and cloud-ready modularity matter as much as feature delivery in enterprise insurance systems.
